description: REAL BUG in shipped code (kopi-beans 0.1.7), not a flake. Caught by the develop->main merge gate via proc::tests::stalled_child_gets_killed_at_the_deadline. The TEST IS CORRECT -- do not touch it. Full write-up and empirical proof in GitHub issue gh-77.
title: kopi-beans: output_before_deadline watchdog defeated by surviving grandchildren -- bn sync can still hang past its budget
